# v8.0.1 — Module 8 published section-status synchronization

This is a **documentation-only patch** to the complete Module 8 v8.0.0 publication.

## Corrected

- Updates Section A, B and C overview status banners that still incorrectly described Module 8 as a review candidate, unfinished or awaiting final release approval.
- Adds a shared repository check to prevent those obsolete pre-release status statements from being reintroduced.
- Aligns the repository's latest-release pointers, citation version and changelog.

## Unchanged

- All eight completed modules' lessons, teaching text, quizzes, diagrams, synthetic data, capstones, formulas and calculations.
- All **42 Module 8 lessons**, **45 SVG diagrams**, **47 fictional datasets**, and **89 answered learning checks**.
- The original Modules 1–7 baseline and the published v8.0.0 tag/release.
